The true story behind America's most famous ghost story — what's actually documented about the Bell family of Adams, Tennessee, and what only comes from a book written seventy years after the fact.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations to tell a researched, source-checked history.

Sources: Wikipedia (Bell Witch); Mental Floss; World History Encyclopedia; Goodspeed's History of Tennessee (1886); Martin Van Buren Ingram, An Authenticated History of the Bell Witch (1894)

#BellWitch #TennesseeHistory #AmericanFolklore
